facts: The paper presents a word segmentation system in France Telecom R&D Beijing.
The word segmentation system uses a unified approach to word breaking.
The word segmentation system uses a unified approach to OOV identification.
The output can be customized to meet different segmentation standards.
The output can be customized through the application of an ordered list of transformation.
The system participated in all the tracks of the segmentation bakeoff.
The system achieved the state-of-the-art performance in MSR-open.
The system achieved the state-of-the-art performance in MSR-close.
The system achieved the state-of-the-art performance in PK-open.
Analysis of the results shows that each component of the system contributed to the scores.
